content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text treats the Romans 1:3 paternity issue as underdetermined because there is no explicit textual resolution, which invokes the chain-against-chain weighing governed by the rule.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "by footing / explicit textual resolution: (1) weigh the support of each chain holistically against the other, or (2) leave the point underdetermined because no verse explicitly resolves it.", "why": "The judge leaves the link underdetermined for lack of explicit textual resolution, which is the retired stating-verse/direct-text test rather than chain-against-chain weighing by footing."}
